sections.title: The letter a
paragraphs: You call this letter (a) /a/. Its main sound is the sound /a/, as in (ami) /a.mi/, which means friend. This letter makes two sounds in French.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: For the front sound, drop your jaw wide. Lay your tongue flat and forward in your mouth. For the back sound, pull your tongue slightly back into your throat and widen your mouth. Your vocal cords vibrate for both sounds. You can touch your throat to feel that vibration.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: You pronounce the regular letter or the accented letter with a grave accent as the front sound /a/, as in (là) /la/. You pronounce the letter with a circumflex accent as the deeper back sound /ɑ/, that is a back vowel, as in (pâte) /pɑt/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into the sound in cat. Keep your mouth open and relaxed, like the vowel in father. Do not glide to another sound at the end, as in day. Hold one steady vowel until the sound stops.
